# LinkedIn Post Template

## Hook
- Start with a bold but credible opening line.

## Context
- One short paragraph on what changed or what you observed.

## Core Insight
- 2 to 4 bullets with practical takeaways:
- Takeaway 1
- Takeaway 2
- Takeaway 3

## Personal Angle
- Why this matters to your work or audience.

## CTA
- Invite discussion or direct readers to the full post.
